checks: A checks table availability before committing to the proposed changed time; B concerns a table’s material and C the literal meaning of move. Blind answer matched. All zh-TW text and option rationales reviewed; actual audio transcribed offline against exact ranges. Not runtime/browser testing.

activeQuestion.prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 聆聽問題或陳述，選出最合適的回應。

options.text: Let me check whether a table is available.
options.zh: 讓我確認是否還有空桌。
options.whyZh: 更改訂位需要確認該時段的空位，符合服務情境。

options.text: The table is made of wood.
options.whyZh: 材質與訂位時間調整無關。
move a reservation 指改時間，不是搬家。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 更改訂位需要確認該時段的空位，符合服務情境。
activeQuestion.evidence: Could we move our reservation to seven thirty?

vocabulary.note: 本題指餐廳的桌位預約。

group.title: Table reservation
group.passage:
Could we move our reservation to seven thirty?
A. Let me check whether a table is available.
B. The table is made of wood.
C. I moved here last year.
